bugs.error_message: Documented brand bugs remained before Feature A: residual Bricolage font references, FYME teal #057570 in knowledge seed data, and unaccented Manha timetable label.
bugs.root_cause: Previous brand pass left a few residual literal values in lower-traffic pages and seed data; timetable stored value was being rendered directly.
bugs.fix: Use font.display for residual headings, replace FYME teal with Movy purple in knowledge seeds, and add a timetable display label map while preserving the stored Manha value.

bugs.error_message: PowerShell treated an unquoted path segment containing (protected) as a command while running git diff.
bugs.root_cause: Paths with parentheses were passed to PowerShell without quoting.
bugs.fix: Reran the command with quoted paths and kept later Git path arguments quoted.

bugs.error_message: git clone --local failed from the Google Drive workspace with 'failed to create link ... Improper link'.
bugs.root_cause: The local clone attempted to hardlink Git objects from the Google Drive-backed workspace.
bugs.fix: Created the validation clone with git clone --no-local and copied the changed files into that clone for validation.

bugs.error_message: Pages had a 'white cut' at the bottom and large hero text appeared sliced by the topbar (both themes, worse in dark) when scrolling.
bugs.root_cause: Containers used 100vh (ignores mobile dynamic toolbar) and the html/body default background (white) showed behind the AppShell; the sticky blurred topbar overlapped scrolling content.
bugs.fix: Switched 100vh to 100dvh, set html/body background to var(--bg), and restructured the layout so the topbar is static and only <main> scrolls internally (overflow-y:auto).

bugs.error_message: Many screens rendered dark-on-dark (invisible text) in dark mode.
bugs.file: components/cambio/*; components/wiki/*; components/study-plans/*; settings/*; financial; departments; home
bugs.root_cause: Components used color.purpleDeep / hardcoded hex (e.g. #2A1153, #fff) as text and surface colors, which do not adapt to the theme.
bugs.fix: Migrated ~29 files to semantic theme tokens (t.text, var(--surface), ink(a)). Kept printed PDF document surfaces white on purpose.

bugs.error_message: GET /pt/manifest.json returned 404.
bugs.root_cause: The manifest link resolved relative to the locale segment and was not excluded from the next-intl + auth middleware matcher.
bugs.fix: Adjusted middleware so the manifest path bypasses i18n/auth (same pattern as /api/*).

bugs.error_message: Login failed for SQL-created user: GoTrue 500 'Database error querying schema'.
bugs.root_cause: User inserted via raw SQL left auth token columns NULL; GoTrue expects empty strings and errors when reading NULLs.
bugs.fix: Set the NULL token columns to '' (empty string). Prefer the Supabase Admin API over raw SQL inserts for auth users.

bugs.error_message: Wiki excerpts had glued text, e.g. 'objetivaOpção A', 'dadosObrigada por entrar'.
bugs.root_cause: Excerpt generation used body.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '') which stripped tags but concatenated adjacent block text with no separator.
bugs.fix: Replace each tag with a space (and bumped low-contrast legend colors to meet WCAG AA).

bugs.error_message: Proposal status shown as 'Draft' (English) in a PT-BR app; native date input rendered US format (MM/DD/YYYY).
bugs.root_cause: Untranslated status label; <input type=date> follows the browser/OS locale, and <html> lacked lang.
bugs.fix: Draft -> Rascunho; set lang="pt-BR" on <html>. Note: native date picker still follows the OS locale (already DD/MM/AAAA on PT-BR machines) — not a real prod bug, would need a custom masked component to force.

bugs.error_message: node --test failed: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND 'lib/calc/money' imported from lib/financial/calculator.ts (and calculations.ts).
bugs.root_cause: Node 24's native type-stripping for `node --test` requires an explicit `.ts` extension on relative VALUE imports; it does not do bundler-style extensionless resolution. Pre-existing relative imports in these files were all `import type` (erased at runtime), so SPLIT 1 was the first time a real value import (`lib/calc/money`) ran under the test loader and failed.
bugs.fix: Added `allowImportingTsExtensions: true` to tsconfig (safe under the existing `noEmit: true`) and used the explicit `'../calc/money.ts'` specifier in the two runtime value imports the test traverses. Other imports stay extensionless (bundler resolution); webpack/Next resolves the physical .ts file. type-check + node --test + build all green afterward.

bugs.error_message: node --test tests/ failed with Error: Cannot find module 'C:\dev\movy-study-plan\tests' (MODULE_NOT_FOUND) when given a directory path.
bugs.root_cause: On this Node/Windows setup `node --test <dir>` did not auto-discover the directory's test files and instead tried to resolve the directory itself as a module entrypoint.
bugs.fix: Pass explicit test file paths instead of a directory: `node --test tests/study-financial.test.mjs tests/crm-contacts.test.mjs`. Keep listing each new test file in the DoD command.

bugs.error_message: parseMoneyToCents misparses thousands-grouped money strings (pt-BR "1.234.567"→1.234 via parseFloat; en-US "1,234" thousands)
bugs.root_cause: Lone-dot/lone-comma inputs were passed to parseFloat which stops at the 2nd separator; no thousands-vs-decimal disambiguation. Flagged as NIT in SPLIT 1 review; dormant (only used in tests) but money border consumed by SPLIT 4.
bugs.fix: Rewrote parseMoneyToCents with locale-aware rules: both separators → rightmost is decimal; lone comma → decimal (pt-BR), repeated → en-US thousands; lone dot → decimal for 1-2 trailing digits, thousands for multiple dots or exactly 3 trailing digits. Added negative handling + tests (1.234→123400, 1.234.567→123456700, 12.34→1234, 1,5→150). 11/11 tests green.

bugs.error_message: Ao trocar de etapa do wizard, o CoursePortfolioPicker perde busca e seletor de preco

bugs.error_message: Modal 'Criar proposta' (lead existente / novo lead) aparece mal posicionado, sem escurecer a tela toda, e o menu do avatar fica por cima
bugs.root_cause: Overlay position:fixed renderizado dentro dos stacking contexts aninhados do app (.movy-atmosphere > * { z-index:1 }), entao nao cobria a viewport nem ficava acima do menu da navbar
bugs.fix: Renderizar o overlay via createPortal(document.body) com z-index 1000 (gate em mounted p/ SSR) + cores em tokens (var(--surface)/var(--border)/var(--text)) p/ dark mode

bugs.error_message: Menu do avatar (conta) nao fecha ao clicar fora
bugs.root_cause: O backdrop de fechar era position:fixed dentro de .navbar-container, que tem backdrop-filter:blur — isso vira containing block p/ fixed, confinando o backdrop a caixa da navbar (clique fora nao era capturado)
bugs.fix: Trocar o backdrop fixed por listener de pointerdown fora do menu + Escape (useRef no container, useEffect quando menuOpen)

bugs.error_message: Conteudo da pagina (titulos, botao + Criar proposta) aparece POR CIMA do dropdown do avatar
bugs.root_cause: O .navbar-container tem backdrop-filter (cria stacking context proprio) e e estatico sem z-index; como vem antes do conteudo no DOM, o conteudo da pagina e pintado acima do menu (z-index:50 do menu so vale DENTRO do contexto da navbar)
bugs.fix: z-index:40 na navbar NAO bastou (botoes de header de pagina como '+ Criar proposta'/'+ Novo conteudo'/'Salvar PDF' ainda vazavam). Fix real: portalar o dropdown via createPortal(document.body) com position:fixed ancorado ao rect do botao do avatar (getBoundingClientRect), z-index 1000, fechando em outside-click/Escape/scroll/resize. Revertido o z-index da navbar.

bugs.error_message: getWeekDates() returned wrong UTC date for users in UTC-5 or earlier late at night, causing clock_in.startsWith(iso) mismatches in WeekSummary
bugs.root_cause: d.toISOString() converts to UTC; at 19:00 local time in UTC-5 it returns the next UTC day
bugs.fix: Replaced toISOString().slice(0,10) with template literal using getFullYear/getMonth/getDate (local time). Moved MAX_HOURS=10 to module level.

bugs.error_message: Mega-audit (C1-C11 + H1-H5): XSS in wiki blocks via dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitizeHtml; silent audit failures; SupabaseClient<any>; service-role client bypasses RLS in portfolio pages; no role checks on HR approve/reject/generateInvoice; no audit logging in HR mutations; dead deleteStudyPlan; inline auth in getShareUrlAction missing role check; FX returns 200 with rate=0 on all-provider-failure; preset update/delete without org_id; no rate limiting on proposal accept
bugs.file: components/wiki/BlockRenderer.tsx, components/wiki/blocks/StepsBlock.tsx, components/wiki/blocks/InfoBox.tsx, lib/api/audit.ts, app/[locale]/(protected)/portfolio/page.tsx, app/[locale]/(protected)/portfolio/[institutionId]/page.tsx, app/[locale]/(protected)/hr/actions.ts, app/[locale]/(protected)/study-plans/actions.ts, app/api/fx/route.ts, app/[locale]/(protected)/settings/presets/actions.ts, app/[locale]/p/[token]/actions.ts, .github/workflows/ci.yml, tests/permissions.test.mjs
bugs.root_cause: Multiple gaps in security hardening: (1) wiki blocks rendered HTML without sanitization, (2) audit.ts swallowed DB failures silently and used SupabaseClient<any>, (3) portfolio pages used service client bypassing RLS for multi-tenant data, (4) HR actions lacked role enforcement and audit trail for sensitive mutations, (5) deleteStudyPlan was unreachable dead code with duplicate auth, (6) FX returning HTTP 200 even when no rate could be fetched is misleading for callers, (7) preset mutations used service client without org_id filter allowing cross-tenant writes, (8) proposal accept had no rate limiting.
bugs.fix: C1: sanitizeHtml() wrapped around all dangerouslySetInnerHTML values; C2: isomorphic-dompurify upgraded to 3.17.0 (dompurify 3.4.10); C3: in-process rate limiter on acceptProposalAction; C4: portfolio pages switched to authenticated createClient() so RLS scopes by org; C5: .github/workflows/ci.yml created; C6: catch {} → catch(err) console.error([AUDIT_FAILED]); C7: logAudit added to approve/reject/generateInvoice; C8: tests/permissions.test.mjs 33/33 pass; C11: deleted deleteStudyPlan dead code; H1: isHrAdmin() gate added to approve/reject/generateInvoice; H2: org_id added to requireAdmin() return, applied to create/update/delete presets; H3: getShareUrlAction replaced inline auth with getActor(); H4: FX returns 503 when rate===0; H5: SupabaseClient<Database> replaces <any,any,any>, removed as never cast.

bugs.error_message: Sistema extremamente lento — toda página demora 1.1s–2s para carregar
bugs.root_cause: Waterfall de 3+ chamadas sequenciais ao Supabase em cada request: (1) middleware.ts chamava auth.getUser() — round-trip HTTP ao Supabase Auth (~300ms); (2) getUser() helper na página chamava auth.getUser() novamente — outro round-trip; (3) hr/page.tsx fazia auth manual duplicada, bypassando o cache() do React; (4) queries no HR eram todas sequenciais (getEmployee → getActiveClock → listEntries → listEmployees).
bugs.fix: middleware.ts: trocado auth.getUser() por auth.getSession() (lê cookie localmente, sem rede). hr/page.tsx: substituído auth manual pelo helper getUser() com cache React; queries paralelas via Promise.all([getActiveClockEntry, listTimeEntries, listEmployeesWithNames]). study-plans/page.tsx: getUser() + query study_plans executados em parallel via Promise.all.
